claude_proposed_widenings.name: shared charge-backed magic-item spell menu with per-spell cast timing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family has one item-level activationCost, but this item exposes one shared charge pool across a menu that includes a reaction spell and longer-cast spells. The shared resource shape exists; the per-spell timing shape does not.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_cube_of_force.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
